decisions.notes: All 12 views inspected. Round buckler with a domed steel boss carrying a punched sun motif, three concentric brass rings, a rivet row and a rolled brass rim. The bottom view confirms a real leather-lined grip bar with metal loops on the reverse, so it can actually be held or strapped to a forearm. Free-standing with no display furniture. Unrigged static prop.
limitations: Stylised Cozy-kit palette rather than photoreal materials.
The grip is fused to the shell.
No arm straps are modelled, only the central grip.

decisions.notes: All 12 views inspected. Centre-cab diesel shunter with two long hoods, cream cab roof, body-side louvre grilles, walkway handrails on both sides, roof fans and horns, headlight and marker lenses, buffers and couplers at both ends, and two three-axle bogies with modelled brake gear. The underside view shows a complete chassis, fuel tank and bogie frames rather than a hollow shell. Both ends are fully modelled and the model is symmetric as a centre-cab unit should be. No operator name, number or logo anywhere.
limitations: Stylised Cozy-kit palette rather than photoreal materials.
Wheels and bogies are part of the single body mesh, so unlike the Grab3D road vehicles this cannot be given a wheel-roll clip without separating the mesh.
Cab interior is not modelled; the window glass is a separate opaque-ish lens node.

decisions.notes: All 12 views inspected. Flywheel with a machined clutch face, a bolt-circle of six dowel holes, a central pilot bore, a ring gear with individually cut starter teeth around the full circumference, and dowel pins on the reverse. Both faces are modelled and different, and the ring-gear teeth are real geometry visible in the edge-on views. The disc is a SEPARATE `_rotor` node, so a spin clip can be authored.
limitations: Stylised Cozy-kit palette rather than photoreal materials.
Tooth count and bolt pattern are illustrative rather than matched to a real engine.

decisions.notes: All 12 views inspected. Retro step-through moped with a pressed frame, a finned single-cylinder engine, an exhaust and silencer, a chain case, telescopic front forks, twin rear shocks with modelled springs, spoked wheels, valanced mudguards, a headlamp and lens, mirrors, a bench seat, a rear luggage rack, a kickstand and a BLANK number plate. No manufacturer badge, script or wordmark appears on the tank, side panels or plate. Front and rear wheels, the crank and a steering node are SEPARATE, so motion clips can be authored.
limitations: Stylised Cozy-kit palette rather than photoreal materials.
The number plate is deliberately blank; add your own registration if needed.
The chain and rear suspension are static.

decisions.notes: All 12 views inspected. Welded tank car with a dished-end cylindrical tank, saddle bands, a top walkway with handrails and a domed manway, an access ladder, a flat underframe with buffers and couplers, and two bogies. The top view shows the manway and valve detail and the underside shows a complete frame. No hazardous-material placards, reporting marks or logos.
limitations: Stylised Cozy-kit palette rather than photoreal materials.
Wheels are fused to the body.
No placards are modelled; add your own if the scene needs them.
